# dataset_files { #labdata.remote.dataset_files }

```python
labdata.remote.dataset_files(entry, commit, client=None)
```

List the parts of a dataset at one commit.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

<code>[**entry**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[Entry](`labdata.model.Entry`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Entry naming the dataset.

<code>[**commit**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[str](`str`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Commit sha to read at.

<code>[**client**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[Optional](`typing.Optional`)\[[Client](`labdata.github.Client`)\]]{.parameter-annotation} [ = ]{.parameter-default-sep} [None]{.parameter-default}</code>

:   Client to read with. Defaults to a new one.

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

<code>[]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[List](`typing.List`)\[[Tuple](`typing.Tuple`)\[[str](`str`), [str](`str`), [int](`int`)\]\]]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Tuples of ``(path, blob_sha, size)``, sorted by path.
